publicrecords/calibration-ledger: Use when someone cites a forecast from an institution (IMF, OECD, Fed/FOMC, SPF, ECB SPF or a listed issuer) and you need to know how accurate that institution's past forecasts were. Returns error distribution, bias and worst misses with source links, or an explicit no-coverage answer.
pintostudio/economic-calendar-data-inves: Use when you need scheduled macro releases with actual vs forecast vs previous values (Investing.com economic calendar) by country, importance and date range.
scrapemint/stock-earnings-estimates: Use when you need analyst EPS estimates vs reported earnings for a US stock, beat/miss history and recent estimate revisions.
fatihtahta/kalshi-scraper: Use when you need current Kalshi prediction-market prices, volumes and categories.
parsebird/polymarket-scraper: Use when you need Polymarket leaderboard rankings and trader profiles (profit/loss, volume, positions).
ryanclinton/wayback-machine-search: Use when you need archived Wayback Machine snapshots of a URL or domain over time, e.g. to see what a page said on a past date.
data_xplorer/google-news-scraper-fast: Use when you need recent Google News articles for a query (title, source, date, URL, image).
